- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast for high sentiment periods.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.33), model underestimates; increase forecast to account for bearish sentiment bias.
- Model often overshoots after sharp spikes in sentiment or price; apply a 1–2 day lag correction to avoid overreaction.
- Mean reversion is evident in 30d forecasts: if model shows extreme highs/lows, adjust toward recent 18-day average.
- Forecasts with sentiment volatility (rapid swings) show higher error; dampen forecast sensitivity to sentiment shifts.
- For 30d horizon, model frequently overpredicts late-period (last 7–10 days) values; cap forecast growth after day 15–20 to avoid horizon distortion.
